columns_and_units.inst_id: OKX USDT-margined perpetual swap instrument ID (string)
columns_and_units.funding_time_ms: Original OKX fundingTime in Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC)
columns_and_units.funding_time_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp derived from funding_time_ms
columns_and_units.ts_snapped_ms: Grid-snapped settlement timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC)
columns_and_units.ts_snapped_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp derived from ts_snapped_ms
columns_and_units.funding_rate: Per-settlement funding rate as decimal (e.g. 0.0001 = 0.01% = 1 bps)
columns_and_units.is_8h_grid: Boolean ('true' if ts_snapped_ms % 28800000 == 0, else 'false' for non-8H settlement frequency)
columns_and_units.source_ym: Origin archive month tag (YYYY-MM) or 'l1_backfill' for public REST backfill

gap_and_dedup_policy.missing_8h_handling: Missing 8H grid events are recorded as miss_8h, NOT zero-filled, NOT interpolated, and NOT excluded from position holding; missing funding still impacts cashflow so performance is conditional rather than full net performance.
gap_and_dedup_policy.non_8h_denominator_note: Cross-frequency (non-8H, e.g. 1H/2H/4H) historical funding schedule denominator completeness is unverified and tracked separately.
